title: What Circular Fashion Platforms Is
definition: Circular Fashion Platforms: platforms keeping clothes in use.
description:
Strip Circular Fashion Platforms to its essence and you get platforms keeping clothes in use. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Art, Design & Fashion: first resale rails understanding, then platform logistics prototypes, then authentication operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of platform hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

t: Real Research Today: Circular Fashion Platforms
title: Real Research Today: Circular Fashion Platforms
definition: Today's documented research behind Circular Fashion Platforms.
description:
The road to Circular Fashion Platforms is already being paved. Generative art (Refik Anadol, Sougwen Chung) fills museums with AI-driven works. The Victoria & Albert Museum collects digital and bio-design as heritage.

The Fashion for Good museum and Global Fashion Agenda push circular fashion. Together these programs form the resale rails foundation that Circular Fashion Platforms will build on — the platform logistics results, the authentication methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as platform logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Circular Fashion Platforms
definition: Estimates Circular Fashion Platforms readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Circular Fashion Platforms components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a platform hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Circular Fashion Platforms Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Circular Fashion Platforms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Circular Fashion Platforms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 14008 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where resale rails monitoring, platform logistics redundancy, or authentication maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Circular Fashion Platforms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Circular Fashion Platforms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Circular Fashion Platforms — platforms keeping clothes in use.

Phase 1 — Prove (resale rails): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (platform logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (authentication): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (repair networks): platform hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
